name: agent-status
description: Real delegate tree and /agents with a delayed running child, quick completed child, stream-error child, and an unknown ui-walk model that fails locally with HTTP 404. All calls are local scripted replies, every child explicitly uses isolation:none, and no tools touch real files or execute commands.

main.text: I’ll delegate four offline status fixtures.

tasks.title: Inspect delayed status fixture
tasks.prompt: Return the scripted delayed report. Do not access files or execute commands.

tasks.title: Review quick completion fixture
tasks.prompt: Return the scripted quick report. Do not access files or execute commands.

tasks.title: Check stream error fixture
tasks.prompt: Receive the scripted stream error. Do not access files or execute commands.

tasks.title: Check missing model fixture
tasks.prompt: Exercise an HTTP 404 using an intentionally unknown local model. Do not access files or execute commands.

main.text: Status fixtures settled. Inspect each child's badge for its outcome. No files changed, no commands executed, and no live calls were made.

child-delayed.text: Inspecting the offline fixture; still working.

child-done.text: Quick completion fixture done. No changes or commands.
